notes:
v0.6.35: fix port layout to match g90digi (launcher :80, wizard :8080).

The bootstrap's previous port layout was inverted from the
deployed g90digi fleet:

  Fresh build:           g90digi (target):
  :80  = ReticulumHF     :80  = shared launcher (daily driver)
  :8090 = shared launcher :8080 = ReticulumHF wizard
                          :8081 = node-portal (wifi admin)

The wifi clients that join the g90's AP need to land on the
launcher (it's the daily-driver UI for flrig/js8call/wsjtx/
modem73/meshchat/freedvtnc2/Reticulum). Port :80 is what the
captive-portal redirect points at, so the launcher has to be
on :80. The ReticulumHF wizard can sit on :8080 — it's only
used during initial setup, not as a daily driver.

Fix (per operator 2026-09-09 15:26 MDT):
- Launcher systemd unit: LAUNCHER_PORT=80 (was 8090). The
  unit is now self-documenting about why :80 is right.
- Bootstrap default: LAUNCHER_PORT=80 (was 8090).
- Bootstrap adds a patch to the upstream ReticulumHF wizard
  (/opt/reticulumhf/setup-portal/app.py), which hardcodes
  port 80 in its app.run() call. The patch makes it read
  PORT from env, defaulting to 8080. Then a systemd drop-in
  /etc/systemd/system/reticulumhf-portal.service.d/port.conf
  exports PORT=8080 so the wizard binds to :8080.
- Template: ReticulumHF link :80/ → :8080/ (matches the
  wizard's new port).
- Bootstrap creates /etc/reticulumhf/.setup_complete so
  freedvtnc2.service starts (its unit has
  ConditionPathExists=!/file). Delete to re-run the wizard.

Effect: clicking the ReticulumHF link from the launcher now
opens the wizard on :8080 (matching g90digi). freedvtnc2
interface button works. New fresh builds match the g90digi
fleet layout exactly.
